name: SEO
description: 提升站点在搜索引擎与社交平台上的展示效果，并生成供搜索引擎抓取的站点地图。
author: RiceNote

description.zh-CN: 影响 head.end 中注入的 meta 标签。修改后需重启服务生效。
description.en: Controls the meta tags injected into head.end. A restart is required after changes.

description.zh-CN: 微信、飞书等以 og:* 决定分享卡片的标题与图片
description.en: og:* tags drive link previews in most social apps

description.zh-CN: 形如 @ricenote；留空则不输出 twitter:site
description.en: For example @ricenote; leave empty to omit twitter:site

description.zh-CN: 文章没有封面时使用；可填媒体库相对路径（/uploads/...）或完整 URL
description.en: Used when a post has no cover image; a site-relative path or an absolute URL

description.zh-CN: 结构化数据，帮助搜索引擎识别文章与站点信息
description.en: Structured data that helps search engines understand posts and the site

description.zh-CN: 关闭某一项会同时移除其公开路由（/sitemap.xml 或 /robots.txt）。
description.en: Disabling an item also removes its public route (/sitemap.xml or /robots.txt).

description.zh-CN: 达到上限后截断，并在运行日志中记录
description.en: Stops collecting after this many URLs and logs a warning

description.zh-CN: 每次向文章服务索取多少条记录
description.en: How many posts are fetched from the posts service per page

description.zh-CN: 每行一条路径前缀，例如 /admin；留空则只输出 Allow: /
description.en: One path prefix per line, e.g. /admin; empty means Allow: / only
